mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing 250 on oak leaves and the old Catholic church in New Orleans with a mounted figure in front, which he only afterwards learned is a Civil War monument, with someone helping him research what it means.
mentions.quote: it had 250 on the big oak of the oak leaves
mentions.falsify_match: The number 250 resolves to a dated event tied to New Orleans or the Louisiana Purchase.
mentions.falsify_miss: The number never resolves. He is researching the meaning after the vision rather than before.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the woman's face in the vision as full cheeked without a defined jawline, neither thin nor fat, reminding him of Latin American women, and says he does not know how else to describe it.
mentions.quote: She reminded me of almost somebody from the South America
mentions.falsify_match: The figure is later identified.
mentions.falsify_miss: The figure is never identified.

mentions.claim_text: Looking at a Mother Mary figure, he says the Lord told him a Judas will rise in America, spoke of a certain individual, and that the true root of it was antisemitism deep inside his heart.
mentions.quote: a Judas will rise in America
mentions.falsify_match: A prominent American figure emerges whose betrayal is driven by antisemitism.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such figure emerges. He does not name the individual.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw covenants made and covenants kept but that yours was not kept, concerning the Catholic Church and New Orleans, and that America would not be what it is without the Louisiana Purchase.
mentions.quote: covenants made, covenants kept, but you didn't keep yours
mentions.falsify_match: Judgment falls on New Orleans or Louisiana traceable to this framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing follows and the covenant language stays uninterpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He contrasts the mindset of someone quitting with someone still thriving, saying an eighty one year old should not be running a country or driving a car, and says he saw a lot while praying into it.
mentions.quote: I don't think she could she can't even run her car at 81
mentions.falsify_match: The named congressional leaders leave office.
mentions.falsify_miss: They remain in place.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a list of the president's buildings in foreign countries believed to be high interest targets, and says he is specifically concerned about New York and the 41st floor.
mentions.quote: there's a list that they're believing that are high interest
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on a Trump property abroad or in New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen Trump locations in New York and Chicago on fire, exploding and with things falling down from deliberate sabotage, and will keep praying over the headquarters and the family.
mentions.quote: I've seen them on fire. I've seen them exploding
mentions.falsify_match: A Trump building suffers a fire or explosion from sabotage.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event.

mentions.claim_text: He asks prayer for the president's mind and that he finish strong, says people get angry with him, and that he tells what he sees rather than taking a political side.
mentions.quote: Pray for him to make it and finish strong
mentions.falsify_match: The president completes the term with his faculties intact.
mentions.falsify_miss: A health or cognitive event ends the term early.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a snake with reptilian eyes leaving California and heading toward the White House, licking the dirt, and says he feels in his heart it is Rubio and that there is a hand on him.
mentions.quote: I feel in my heart it's Rubio
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio moves toward the presidency in the way described.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. Elsewhere he corrects the same image to a chameleon and rejects the reptilian reading, which cuts against this telling.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are about to see the greatest outpouring ever seen, with the Davids and Esthers and the greatest tangible experience of the glory in this generation, calling it Azusa on steroids.
mentions.quote: It will be Azusa on steroids
mentions.falsify_match: A revival exceeding Azusa Street in scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is centred around New York and praying over the buildings and over what they will call a new ground zero.
mentions.quote: praying over what they will call ground zero. A new ground zero
mentions.falsify_match: A New York site is publicly called a new ground zero after an attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against every plot on the American electric grid from Iran and from Chinese infiltration, says he sees Chinese influence over the grid making moves, and that it is over the cyber and will be over the banks with embarrassment.
mentions.quote: I see Chinese influence over our electric grid
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese-attributed intrusion into American grid systems is confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such intrusion is found.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over Europe and the Ukrainian president, he thanks God for exposing fraud and repeats Swiss accounts several times.
mentions.quote: Much much fraud in the Swiss accounts
mentions.falsify_match: Swiss-held funds tied to Ukraine aid are exposed.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such exposure.

mentions.claim_text: He continues on the Swiss accounts and the fraud, and moves into the black horse riding.
mentions.quote: the fraud in the Swiss accounts and the black horse riding
mentions.falsify_match: A financial scandal in Swiss accounts alongside European scarcity.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither materialises.

mentions.claim_text: He sees an Islamic state turning green and Europe turning green with white swirly Arabic writing on it.
mentions.quote: I see Europe turning green. With the writing. It's like Arabic
mentions.falsify_match: Islamic political dominance across Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such shift.

mentions.claim_text: He says much oil will come up out of Iraq, that Iraq and Saudi Arabia will be like friends, and corrects himself from a united Syria to a united Saudi Arabia and Iraq.
mentions.quote: There'll be much much oil coming up out of Iraq
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi output and Saudi cooperation rise together.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such alignment.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Turkey and Syria forming a brotherhood and a great strong friendship with alliances, alongside the Black Sea and drought.
mentions.quote: there'll be brotherhood. A great strong friendship is being formed
mentions.falsify_match: A formal Turkey and Syria alliance.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such alliance. Turkey has been the principal backer of the post-Assad Syrian government since 2024, so a close relationship is already the standing position.

mentions.claim_text: He sees wheat concerning Ukraine and the black horse riding, moving from Europe with drought, bank accounts and money.
mentions.quote: I see the wheat concerning Ukraine. And I see the black horse riding
mentions.falsify_match: Ukrainian grain disruption produces European scarcity.
mentions.falsify_miss: Grain flows continue.

mentions.claim_text: He says the money is in bank accounts hiding in Swiss accounts, then moves to Israel and fruit the size of softballs.
mentions.quote: the money is in the bank accounts hiding in the Swiss accounts
mentions.falsify_match: Hidden Swiss holdings tied to the war are uncovered.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such uncovering.

mentions.claim_text: He sees great blessing on Israel and its land prospering, with huge fruit, and people jealous and angry asking how it is possible.
mentions.quote: I see the land of Israel prospering and people are jealous
mentions.falsify_match: Israeli agricultural output rises markedly and draws international attention.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such change.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a new leader for Israel in the background and in the shadow, a good hearted and very orthodox religious man, rising up soon.
mentions.quote: I see a new leader for Israel rising up soon. Very orthodox
mentions.falsify_match: An observant religious figure becomes Israeli prime minister.
mentions.falsify_miss: A secular figure succeeds instead.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the temple, a blessing on Israel, the Saudi crown prince and an antichrist figure doing the art of the deal at the table, and says explicitly that it is not Trump.
mentions.quote: I see the art of the deal at the table, but it's not Trump
mentions.falsify_match: A single figure brokers a temple and Israel agreement and is later identified as an antichrist figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such figure.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the man at the table where Jesus was as wearing a gold band around his head with black and gold writing on it, and a white head covering.
mentions.quote: a gold band around his head with a black thing
mentions.falsify_match: A Gulf figure in traditional headdress brokers the temple agreement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such figure. The description matches ordinary Gulf Arab dress.

mentions.claim_text: He sees great prosperity on Israel with many fish in a land of drought, fish and fruit and blessing, and says he keeps being shown fish in a basket.
mentions.quote: I see so many fish in a land of drought
mentions.falsify_match: Israeli food production rises while the region is in drought.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such contrast.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that judgment begins in the house of the Lord first, with a stirring in the churches, pastors, teachers and evangelists, and one more push and outpouring.
mentions.quote: their judgment begins in the house of the Lord first
mentions.falsify_match: A visible shaking and division inside American church institutions.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such shaking.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking of a fire shut up in the bones and a blessing from sea to shining sea, he says again that he sees an earthquake hitting California at Malibu.
mentions.quote: I just see a earthquake hitting California, Malibu
mentions.falsify_match: A damaging earthquake at Malibu.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: He says fish were dying and the animals knew, that God put it in the animals to know when danger is about to happen, that a great shaking will bring people to their knees and the bride to his side, and that he saw a shaking in Japan.
mentions.quote: I have put it in the animals to know when danger is about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: Mass animal die-offs or unusual behaviour precede a major earthquake.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such correlation. Fish die-offs have many ordinary causes.

mentions.claim_text: He describes plants growing up inside tire tracks so that the tracks bear fruit and dormant seeds come to life, says he knows it is symbolic and does not know what it means.
mentions.quote: I know it's symbolic. I don't know what that means
mentions.falsify_match: Something later resolves the image.
mentions.falsify_miss: The image stays unresolved, which he states in advance.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown a 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Mexico that day and confirms it is on the ring of fire.
mentions.quote: we have a 7.4 magnitude earthquake happened in Mexico today
mentions.falsify_match: A cluster of magnitude 6 and 7 events around the ring of fire.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ordinary seismic rates. The ring of fire produces roughly fifteen magnitude 7 events a year.

mentions.claim_text: Correcting the magnitude to 7.3, he says it always has fruit, that you do not want to be flaky, and that it is amazing it happened a couple of hours after prayer.
mentions.quote: You don't want to be flaky
mentions.falsify_match: Earthquakes reliably follow his prayer times.
mentions.falsify_miss: The timing is coincidence. A magnitude 7 somewhere on the ring of fire in any given fortnight is close to even odds.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will take the Senate but not by a landslide, that they will get both, and that seven more seats were needed to pass things including the Save America Act.
mentions.quote: I keep seeing they'll get the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans hold the Senate in 2026 without a landslide.
mentions.falsify_miss: They lose the Senate, or win it by a landslide.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown that France met Germany to do nuclear work together and that Paris and Berlin vowed to align on tougher trade measures, and wonders aloud what it will mean.
mentions.quote: They're going to do nuclear work. I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A France and Germany nuclear and trade bloc forms.
mentions.falsify_miss: The talks come to nothing.

mentions.claim_text: He identifies drones in footage as the ones he said he saw being used in Cuba, better than what can be bought online and carrying a payload underneath.
mentions.quote: they're better than the ones you can get off of Amazon
mentions.falsify_match: Armed drones of that type are confirmed in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: Praying, he sees a glimpse of Malibu again and a man in mirrored aviator sunglasses, repeated several times without identification.
mentions.quote: I saw a glimpse of Malibu again
mentions.falsify_match: An event at Malibu involving an identifiable figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing at Malibu, and the man is never identified.

mentions.claim_text: He sees one oak tree that he says is America, and says it has something to do with New Orleans and an agreement made out of New Orleans.
mentions.quote: It's a one oak tree. And I see one oak tree
mentions.falsify_match: The oak and the New Orleans agreement resolve to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: They stay unresolved. He says he does not know what the oak tree is.

mentions.claim_text: He says she is well protected, that they are not even looking in her direction, that she is in her own bubble at Mar-a-Lago and protected in New York too.
mentions.quote: they ain't even looking her direction
mentions.falsify_match: No threat materialises against her.
mentions.falsify_miss: A threat or attack against her occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he was shown about the five keys and the Louisiana Purchase was amazing but that he has no idea what any of it was and will do history lessons that night.
mentions.quote: I have no idea what any of that was
mentions.falsify_match: The five keys resolve to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: They stay unresolved. He states plainly he is researching the meaning afterwards.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a report of voter fraud and Chinese interference with American elections naming Michigan, says he hoped Minnesota would be named because he has been praying over it and Atlanta, and that he has seen it in Arizona.
mentions.quote: voter fraud and China interfering with our elections
mentions.falsify_match: Documented election interference in the named states.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such findings.

mentions.claim_text: He reminds the audience of something in the water concerning the deep water, saying he does not know whether it is real, and moves on to praying for Iraq and a wealth transfer.
mentions.quote: This is going to be in the water and it's something about the deep water
mentions.falsify_match: An event in deep water that he later ties to this.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing follows. He says himself he does not know whether it is real.

mentions.claim_text: He says Iran is taking its hands off Iraq's affairs, that a principality had hold of Iraq, and that he saw a pipeline, oil wealth out of the ground and stability with much corruption remaining, while Iran goes back to the stone age.
mentions.quote: I saw Iran going back to the stone age
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian infrastructure is set back decades while Iraq stabilises and grows.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iran recovers and Iraq stays constrained.

mentions.claim_text: He says an unstable Iran is dangerous to the whole area and that he saw Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and other Arab nations join a coalition putting troops on the ground rather than only conducting air strikes.
mentions.quote: it wouldn't just be air strikes anymore
mentions.falsify_match: Arab ground forces deploy into Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Arab ground deployment.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they turn from their wicked ways and humble themselves he will put a hedge of protection over South Korea, and that he saw a Chinese looking dragon spirit coming out of China through North Korea trying to infiltrate.
mentions.quote: I will have a hedge of my protection over South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: South Korea resists a communist turn.
mentions.falsify_miss: South Korea turns. The condition attached means either outcome is explained.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be an end time Azusa Street in Asia in South Korea, with waves of revival going into China, the Philippines, Taiwan and Japan, and recalls an old stagnant well of revival.
mentions.quote: there will be an endtime Azusa Street in Asia in South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival movement originating in South Korea spreading across Asia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says the influence is a spirit rather than flesh and blood, a dragon coming through communist China into North Korea, and refers back to something he said on the 11th.
mentions.quote: it's a dragon that is coming through communistic China through North Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese influence over South Korean politics becomes overt.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such influence appears. The claim is about a spirit, so it cannot be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for prayer for South Korea and for a young man on probation who expects to be thrown back into jail, saying his church there appears sizeable.
mentions.quote: he's on probation. He's expecting them to throw him back into jail
mentions.falsify_match: The person is imprisoned again.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not imprisoned.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for a Hail Mary play to push the Clarity Act and the Save America Act through so that there is a major enthusiastic turnout for the midterms.
mentions.quote: believe for the Clarity Act, the Save America Act, to push all these bills
mentions.falsify_match: Both bills pass before the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither passes. He calls it a Hail Mary himself, which concedes the odds.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that ten million dollars will be given to anyone who kills the president, sourced to Iraq, notes the contrast with the Iraqi optimism he had just expressed, and says it will not stand.
mentions.quote: they will give $10 million to anyone who kills President Trump
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt on the president traced to that reward.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attempt follows.

mentions.claim_text: Against twenty eight inches of rain in ten hours and catastrophic flooding, he says believers have power and authority over the weather and declares peace over the weather in San Antonio.
mentions.quote: I believe we have power and authority over the weather
mentions.falsify_match: The flooding abates after the declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: The flooding continues or worsens.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw fires being set on purpose and wonders whether that is what is happening in Canada now, noting the major Canadian fires are not in populated areas, and prays for rain over Canada.
mentions.quote: I saw them setting fires on purpose. I saw arson
mentions.falsify_match: Arson is confirmed as a major cause of the Canadian fires.
mentions.falsify_miss: Lightning and drought account for them. He puts it as a question rather than an assertion.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all about seeds and that poverty is killed with a financial seed on the give and it shall be given principle, calling it biblical law against those who object.
mentions.quote: You kill poverty with a financial seed
mentions.falsify_match: Givers are visibly spared the downturn he predicts.
mentions.falsify_miss: Givers fare the same as everyone else. The condition puts any shortfall on the giver.

mentions.claim_text: Following a word he cannot make out, he says the Lord told him this will happen in Japan also, repeating Japan several times.
mentions.quote: the Lord said this will happen in Japan also
mentions.falsify_match: The Japanese event he has described occurs.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. What this refers to is not stated in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He commands persecution over South Korea to stop, then says the Lord showed him it gets people out of complacency and wakes a church that has gone asleep.
mentions.quote: It's to wake the church up. It's gone asleep
mentions.falsify_match: Persecution in South Korea coincides with church growth there.
mentions.falsify_miss: Persecution reduces attendance instead. He asks it to stop and then says it serves a purpose, which covers both.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him this happened because of complacency, not in every case but in the majority, and that the same has happened in America and in Europe.
mentions.quote: the Lord said this happened because of complacency
mentions.falsify_match: Church decline in those regions is tracked to complacency and reverses under pressure.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such pattern. This is an explanation rather than a prediction.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a stirring in Australia repeatedly and says revivalists are going to be set ablaze upon America.
mentions.quote: A revivalist is going to be set ablaze upon America
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival movement in Australia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement. He has previously reported nothing happened after an earlier watch Australia word.

mentions.claim_text: He remarks on criticism over someone making two billion dollars and over that person's children, says he finds it annoying, and states he will stay neutral and pray.
mentions.quote: they were upset he made $2 billion
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a comment on news coverage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.
